    cbounds = [-1] + vdiv + [w]

    ctiles = [(cbounds[i] + 1, cbounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(cbounds) - 1)]

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1 in rtiles:
        # Scan left to right. An occupied tile with an empty right neighbor
        # is the source of the reflected partner.
        for j in range(len(ctiles) - 1):
            c0, c1 = ctiles[j]
            n0, n1 = ctiles[j + 1]
